subject.title: Question: Publisher verification path for active code plugin contributors?

question: Should ClawHub define a public vetted-community trust tier distinct from both ordinary community packages and Official publishers?
rationale: This changes a security-sensitive endorsement contract; repository evidence cannot determine the intended review authority, package-versus-publisher scope, expiration, revocation, or assurance wording.

options.title: Define Vetted Community
options.body: Specify package- or publisher-scoped criteria and public semantics in the focused RFC before implementing badges, request workflows, or API states.

options.title: Keep Existing Tiers
options.body: Document that community packages remain unreviewed and rely only on provenance, scanner, moderation, and source-link signals.

recommendation.title: Define Vetted Community
recommendation.body: Specify package- or publisher-scoped criteria and public semantics in the focused RFC before implementing badges, request workflows, or API states.
